statement: Product path changes in a turn or push are either covered by the sealed workstream (graph node.locator under the turn's featureIds and/or slice expectedPaths) or accompanied by an explicit ledger align-waiver bound to the same treeDigest.
rationale: TN-002 forbids unsealed implementation in spirit; without a machine check, agents ship Lattice/UI and core changes with no plan trail. Coverage is path→plan/graph, not verify theater. expectedPaths is now on the workstream slice schema.
